race.title: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: GIMARIAS is the obvious one on the back of his good second to a progressive sort at Chepstow at the beginning of the month. The fact that The Brave Guy went off as short as 5/2 in a competitive race on his handicap debut suggests he's thought better than he showed on that occasion. The low-mileage Elusive Shine is one to monitor closely in the betting on his return from an absence for in-form Sam England. GIMARIAS (IRE) THE BRAVE GUY (IRE) ELUSIVE SHINE (IRE)
